about: A shop of mechanical curiosities designed by Tasmanian maker Shasa Bolton, featuring automata, puzzle boxes, magic tricks, robots, and other buildable contraptions.

automata.name: Automata
automata.description: Wooden automata kits — hand-cranked mechanical animals and birds, machines that write, draw, and animate. Inspired by classical clockwork automata. Learn about mechanisms, gears, cams, and levers as you assemble precision laser-cut parts and bring elegant motion to life.

magic-tricks.name: Magic Tricks
magic-tricks.description: Wooden mechanical magic tricks and illusion kits by Shasa Bolton — build-it-yourself props and ready-made pieces for close-up and parlour magic.

puzzle-boxes.name: Puzzle Boxes
puzzle-boxes.description: Secret-opening puzzle boxes and mechanical brain teasers — laser-cut kits and assembled pieces that reward patience, curiosity, and clever fingers.

toys-and-games.name: Toys and Games
toys-and-games.description: Playful mechanical toys and hands-on games — wooden contraptions for makers, families, and anyone who likes things that move.

whirligigs.name: Whirligigs
whirligigs.description: Wind-powered whirligigs and kinetic garden ornaments — colourful characters that spin and bob in the breeze, as kits or finished pieces.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Notes on design, builds, and behind-the-scenes from Contraption Cart.
